evals.name: trigger-this-isnt-what-i-wanted
evals.expected_output: Triggers misread-capture. Does not defend the work or explain what was understood. The reply does not say what was wanted instead, so exactly one question asks for it. No second question.

evals.name: trigger-you-misunderstood-with-the-want-stated
evals.prompt: You misunderstood — the report was supposed to be for clinicians, not patients.
evals.expected_output: Triggers misread-capture. Asks nothing, because the want is stated. Writes one correction entry to the Misread Ledger that quotes 'for clinicians, not patients', adds or sharpens one check with a concrete trigger, tells the user the check in one sentence, then redoes the report with corrected lock lines on top.

evals.name: trigger-thai
evals.prompt: ไม่ใช่ที่ผมต้องการ
evals.expected_output: Triggers on the Thai phrase. Asks one question in Thai for what was wanted instead.

evals.name: implicit-correction-different-kind
evals.prompt: I wanted a speculative mechanism review, not an evidence report with verdicts.
evals.expected_output: Triggers misread-capture with no complaint phrase: the work was the wrong kind of output. Logs a correction entry and a check without being asked, then redoes the work as a speculative mechanism review.

evals.name: negative-ordinary-follow-up-edit
evals.prompt: Nice. Can you add a short section on pediatric dosing?
evals.expected_output: Does NOT trigger misread-capture. This is a new wish on work that matched the request. The edit is made and nothing is logged. FAILS if a ledger entry is written.

evals.name: negative-mid-interview-clarification
evals.prompt: Wait, actually I meant the staging database, not production — while we're still going back and forth on this.
evals.expected_output: Does NOT trigger misread-capture. No work has been delivered; intent-lock handles it in the current round. FAILS if a ledger entry is written.

evals.name: show-my-checks
evals.expected_output: Reads the active checks from the Misread Ledger, lists them, and gives the ledger page link.
